body:
Instead of checking every condition it would be best to do the following:
1. print a string using `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG()`
2. Create a function that takes in a `VkResult` and returns a string. The implementation of the function can be hidden behind an `#ifdef DEBUG` so that the full error handling is only done for debug builds. we use this pattern in a few places in the source (here for example: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/87318a2fb7fffeb72adca934e31915be077c3d1f/drivers/gles3/storage/texture_storage.h#L706)
